intro: Your friend is playing in the park. Ask to join the game.

conversation.speaker: friend
conversation.text: Hi! We are starting a game of cricket. Do you want to play?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say yes and ask if you can join the game.
expected: Yes, can I join the game?
Yes, I want to play with you.
conversation.hint: Try: "Yes, can I join the game?"

conversation.speaker: friend
conversation.text: Great! Which team do you want to be in?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say which team you want to join.
expected: I want to be in your team.
I would like to join your team.
conversation.hint: Try: "I want to be in your team."

conversation.speaker: friend
conversation.text: You can bat first. Do you know the rules?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say that you know the rules, or ask her to explain them.
expected: No, could you explain the rules?
I know the rules a little.

conversation.speaker: friend
conversation.text: Good. Be careful of the flowers near the bench!

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Promise that you will be careful.
expected: Do not worry, I will be careful.

conversation.speaker: friend
conversation.text: That was a good shot! You play well.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Thank your friend and say you enjoyed the game.
expected: Thank you, I enjoyed the game.
Thank you, it was a good game.
conversation.hint: Try: "Thank you, I enjoyed the game."
